# MovieFigure { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure(
    data=None,
    layout=None,
    frames=None,
    groups=None,
    styles=None,
    meta=None,
)
```

Plotly-like API for building Three.js movie scenes.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [add_cell](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_cell) | Add unit-cell wireframe (static). |
| [add_connections](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_connections) | Add pore-graph connection lines + nodes (internal + optional periodic). |
| [add_framework](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_framework) | Add framework atoms + bonds as a mesh trace (static). |
| [add_guests](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_guests) | Add guest / adsorbate atoms as instanced spheres (single frame, static). |
| [add_maxima](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_maxima) | Add pore-centre maxima points (internal always visible, periodic optionally hidden). |
| [add_surface](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_surface) | Add segmentation isosurface mesh (static). |
| [add_windows](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_windows) | Add window points between connected pores (internal + optional periodic). |
| [export_png](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.export_png) | Export the current static scene to PNG. |
| [set_lights](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.set_lights) | Set Three.js scene lighting (embedded in exported HTML). |
| [show](#mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.show) | Display the figure. |

### add_cell { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_cell }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_cell(atoms, **style)
```

Add unit-cell wireframe (static).

### add_connections { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_connections }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_connections(seg, atoms, hide_periodic=True, **style)
```

Add pore-graph connection lines + nodes (internal + optional periodic).

### add_framework { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_framework }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_framework(
    atoms,
    bonds='auto',
    representation='ball_and_stick',
    **style,
)
```

Add framework atoms + bonds as a mesh trace (static).
representation: "ball_and_stick" (default), "stick", or "space_filling".
When called with default representation, both ball-and-stick and stick
meshes are added; the stick mesh starts hidden and can be toggled in the viewer.

### add_guests { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_guests }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_guests(atoms, color=None, **style)
```

Add guest / adsorbate atoms as instanced spheres (single frame, static).

### add_maxima { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_maxima }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_maxima(seg, atoms, hide_periodic=True, **style)
```

Add pore-centre maxima points (internal always visible, periodic optionally hidden).

### add_surface { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_surface }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_surface(
    dgrid,
    regions,
    atoms,
    isovalue=1.0,
    step_size=1,
    **style,
)
```

Add segmentation isosurface mesh (static).

### add_windows { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_windows }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.add_windows(
    seg,
    hide_periodic=True,
    atoms=None,
    spacing=None,
    reclassify_far_outside=True,
    **style,
)
```

Add window points between connected pores (internal + optional periodic).

When *atoms* and *spacing* are supplied and *reclassify_far_outside* is True,
windows tagged ``internal`` whose Cartesian position is far outside the unit
cell are reclassified as periodic (prevents phantom internal-window markers
for non-orthogonal cells).

### export_png { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.export_png }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.export_png(
    path,
    *,
    resolution_mult=2,
    width=None,
    height=None,
    wait_ms=1500,
)
```

Export the current static scene to PNG.

Uses Playwright headless Chromium when installed::

    pip install playwright
    playwright install chromium

Otherwise raises with instructions to use the in-viewer **Export PNG**
button after ``.show(renderer="browser")``.



#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

path
    Output ``.png`` path.
resolution_mult
    Supersampling factor (matches the viewer Export PNG control).
width, height
    Browser viewport in pixels (default 1280×720).
wait_ms
    Milliseconds to wait for WebGL scene load before capture.

### set_lights { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.set_lights }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.set_lights(
    ambient=None,
    hemisphere_intensity=None,
    hemisphere_sky=None,
    hemisphere_ground=None,
    dir_key_intensity=None,
    dir_key_position=None,
    dir_fill_intensity=None,
    dir_fill_position=None,
    ssao=None,
    explicit=True,
)
```

Set Three.js scene lighting (embedded in exported HTML).

When *explicit* is True (default), the viewer uses these intensities
as-is and does **not** apply the automatic orthographic compensation.



#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

ambient
    Ambient light intensity (0–1 typical).
hemisphere_intensity, hemisphere_sky, hemisphere_ground
    Hemisphere light settings (sky/ground are hex colours).
dir_key_intensity, dir_key_position
    Key directional light.
dir_fill_intensity, dir_fill_position
    Fill directional light.
ssao
    Enable SSAO. Default: off in orthographic, on in perspective.
explicit
    If True, skip orthographic auto-boost of directional lights.

### show { #mofography.threejs_viz.MovieFigure.show }

```python
threejs_viz.MovieFigure.show(renderer='notebook', *, port=None)
```

Display the figure.



#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

renderer
    ``"notebook"`` — display inline in Jupyter output cell (default).
    ``"browser"`` — serve HTML on ``127.0.0.1`` (random free port) and
    open in the system browser (Plotly-style). Also writes a temp HTML
    backup and prints its path.
port
    Optional fixed port for ``renderer="browser"`` (default: auto).



#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

str or None
    Viewer URL when ``renderer="browser"``, else None.
